property_summary: For any role bytes32 and any address actor, calling renounceRole(role, actor) from actor must leave actor without that role (hasRole(role, actor) == false afterwards); the mutant instead grants the role, so hasRole becomes true for any actor that did not already hold it.
change_summary: Replace _revokeRole with _grantRole so a renounce call grants the role instead of revoking it.
